text:
laura: Quick notes from today's design crit on the welcome flow (staging). Keeping short.

ben: drop Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/staging/welcome-flow-starter-strip (frames: starter-strip, sample-studio, consent-toast).

omar: Biggest issue: the starter strip pushes the project list down and hides sorting controls on 13\" laptops. Could we render it as a floating toast anchored to the header instead?

tess: Floating toast makes sense. Also recommend a collapsed micro-pill on narrow viewports that expands into the full strip when tapped or focused.

laura: Copy idea for the strip header: "Start your first project" vs current "Welcome! Get started"  which is clearer? I vote for the former.

ben: Accessibility: make sure the toast/pill has role="region" and aria-label that includes "onboarding" so it appears in landmark nav. Add visible focus ring on the expand control.

omar: Color/contrast: primary CTA (white on brand purple) measures 3.6:1 on the strip. Need to hit 4.5:1 for AA. Options: darker purple, bold outline, or use dark text on light CTA.

tess: Microcopy on sample cards: replace "Try now" with "Use sample" — less ephemeral. Add a 1-line summary under each title and include an accessibility description via aria-describedby.

laura: Behaviour Q: if user dismisses the strip, do we hide forever? I'd prefer a persisted dismiss flag but surface a small "Welcome" icon in the header so they can reopen.

ben: Metrics: onboarding.welcome.viewed, onboarding.welcome.dismissed, onboarding.sample_used. Also track variant property for A/B: strip_vs_toast.

omar: Implementation: feature flag welcome_strip_v4, rollout to 30% beta orgs. We'll stub events behind the flag initially.

ci-bot: staging build passed: welcome-strip-v4 @ commit c3d9a8  preview: https://staging.redwood.dev/welcome.

tess: QA checklist: keyboard nav to expand pill, screen reader announcement on expand (aria-live polite), focus return after closing, contrast fixes.

laura: Decision: use floating toast on small screens with collapsed pill affordance; persist dismiss on user; add header re-open icon; update sample CTA to "Use sample"; fix CTA contrast; track events. Assigning to omar (contrast + flag) and tess (a11y + QA). I'll update the ticket. Thanks!
